Equipment Journal Entry Automation

Python processing that brings several accounting inputs together into SAP-ready templates and reviewable exception files.

  • RoleAutomation design & development
  • TechnologyPython · pandas · openpyxl
  • ContextProfessional work at Graham

The problem

Equipment charges and reallocations depend on invoice details, rate sheets, equipment records, dates, and WBS mappings. Joining those sources manually makes skipped records, inconsistent mappings, and repeated review difficult to avoid.

Approach

I built processing steps that join source data, apply visible date and WBS rules, and produce journal-entry inputs for an SAP template. The workflow also creates review files for skipped invoices, equipment, and WBS values needing a decision.

Key decisions

  • Use pandas for joins, dates, calculations, and exception reporting.
  • Use openpyxl to write Excel-based templates without hiding business decisions.
  • Keep processing windows and mapping tables visible and configurable.
  • Preserve context in exception reports so a reviewer can trace a flag to its invoice, equipment, and WBS.

What it demonstrates

Automation that makes exceptions actionable instead of silently generating a file and hiding missing information.

Publication note

Templates and example data are illustrative. Internal financial inputs and SAP outputs are not shown.
